notes.title: Update 0.91 - Shop improvements
notes.content:
TerraForge v.0.91 is now available!

Hello everyone! :)
I hope you'll like this update as well.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44252786/a1ced7b9ecc0f3426b27e1f5745ccebbf31a0d2f.png

New features & improvements

 Reworked the furniture boost system:
Furniture now gives its boost to the entire shop, no more playing "tetris" with placement. Feel free to decorate however you like and still enjoy the full benefits!
 Added a brand new furniture panel:
Includes detailed info, filters, sorting, so overall a better navigation to help you manage your furniture more easily and efficiently.
 Added a new setting option for enable/disable screen edge scrolling.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where furniture boosts weren’t applied correctly.
 Fixed the top panel in the Smithy not displaying correctly on ultra-wide screens.
 Fixed rare cases where treasure chests could spawn inside bedrock.


As always, thank you all for the support and feedback!
You guys are awesome ;)

notes.title: Hotfix 0.902
notes.content:
TerraForge update 0.902 is now available!

 Fixed a bug where treasure chests and other pickable items sometimes weren’t clickable after being mined out.
 Fixed some furniture items always showing their boost range even when they shouldn't.
 Fixed a few UI scaling issues on ultrawide screens.
 Fixed the logging hut not giving any wood when using the newest (smallest) New Day popup.
 Fixed a bug where the treasure NPC's exchange button (asking for wood) would stay disabled.
 Increased the base license time and further improved the chance to get even longer license times for Adamantite and Celestium mines.

Thank you for playing my game and stay tuned for more ;)

notes.title: Hotfix 0.901
notes.content:
TerraForge update 0.901 is now available!

 Fixed the "fog of war" misplacement bug on ultrawide screens and other resolutions/aspect ratios.
 Fixed the scroll bug that prevented scrolling to the very bottom of mining sites, making them shorter (and less profitable).
 Fixed the wood counter bug where cutting trees in the Mine area didn’t immediately update the wood counter.
 Improved the New Day popup: replaced the checkbox with a dropdown and added a new minimal option that hides most details, showing the smallest possible version of the popup.

Thank you for all the feedback!
Special thanks to DrTuSo, setonix26 and Hade. You guys are awesome!

notes.title: Update 0.9 - Lore book, story, citizens, QoL
notes.content:
TerraForge v.0.9 is now available!

Hey everyone! :)
This update brings some long-requested features, bug fixes, and cool new content—including lore and villagers to make the world feel more alive. Let’s dig into it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44252786/4dc344c30546ad289aedfecd6045dce1328739ae.gif

New features & Content

 Depth Meter: Easily track how deep you are while mining!
 Villagers System: As you rebuild the town, villagers will return! You’ll see them walking, chatting, and hanging around. It’s a small touch, but it adds a lot of life.
 Lore Book: Automatically keeps track of what you’ve learned—resource hotspots, mechanics, and story progression. A super helpful companion for both gameplay and lore lovers!
 More Story Content: Added new pieces of the TerraForge story. Full storyline coming in version 1.0!
 Market Demand Display: Now visible in the Smithy—know exactly what’s in demand!
 Blueprint Filters: Quickly find what you need with new type filters in the Blueprints panel.
 Furniture Booster Shapes: More variation to spice up your shop layout!


Bug Fixes

 Fixed chests spawning outside of the game area.
 Fixed time speed bug when switching from shop to mining.
 Fixed lumbermill wood yield issue with the new day animation.
 Fixed music stopping after switching town scenes.


Other Improvements

 Minor tutorial updates
 Lowered cost of low-tier mining licenses to improve early game pacing


Thanks so much for your support and feedback! Each update is shaped by your ideas and reports.
Feel free to share your feedback and ideas, I'd love to hear them! :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44252786/702a726fa49b7cb40d83e572f0ffe448d27ac094.png

notes.title: Update 0.86 - Treasures, riddles, quick replay
notes.content:
TerraForge v.0.86 is now available!

New features

 Treasure chests: Discover valuable loot hidden underground.
 Traveling sage NPC: He knows valuable insights for a price. Sometimes he gives a riddle, try to solve them ;)
 Replay system: A short timelapse of your mining run. (This feature can be disabled in the settings menu)
 Added a Brightness setting.
 Added a setting toggle for smaller "new day" popup.

Improvements

 Huge improvement on city scene loading. Drastically reduced load time between town, smithy and shop scenes.


Thank you for your continued support and for playing TerraForge!
Your feedback inspires every update ♥

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44252786/2afcea4c2d58af6ca0b0ecce4fdf9aa8d697f37e.gif

notes.title: Update 0.851
notes.content:
TerraForge update 0.851 is now available!


 Ancient Hook Relic Buff: Now guarantees 100% automatic ore collection—no more manual hassle!
 Extended Mining Licenses: Enjoy longer mining days for more time to gather resources.
 Increased Ore Chunk Spawns: More ore chunks mean bigger rewards!
 Reduced Hardrock Density: Narrower paths and more openings for smoother exploration.
 Worms, Drills, and Miners now ignore tiny hardrock and bedrock fragments, preventing slowdowns from "invisible" pixels.


As always, thanks for playing my game and stay tuned for more! ;)

notes.title: Update 0.85 - Mining license rework, mining traps, hardrock and more!
notes.content:
TerraForge v.0.85 is now available!

New features

 Mining licenses rework; Gain influence by completing town missions. Use your influence to discover the perfect site for your desire.
 Mining sites now refresh daily! Keep your favorites locked for later use and never miss out on valuable resources.
 Hardrock layers are now in mining maps, and each tool has unique efficiency for breaking through. Equip wisely for faster, more effective mining!
 Added a bedrock border to visualize the game area of the mining maps. The bedrock is unbreakable.
 Added a key bindings menu to set hotkeys. (more keys are coming soon)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44252786/c89e699c2246a4d7bf2bf949dc3f39dc7a5d6d83.png
Quality of Life Enhancements

 Further performance improvements on mining sites. (About +20% performance/fps)
 Fixed the map scrolling bug when picking up multiple ores.
 Mined ores no longer lose value over time when mining (only 1x rate when collecting)
 Added more buffs to the Inn tiers.


Thank you for playing my game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44252786/fbf1c076013fc58d50ec6143a519553298666168.gif

notes.title: Update 0.822
notes.content:
TerraForge update 0.822 is now available!

New Features:

 Added Rain and Dust Storm weather effects in the city scene.
 Added timers to the Drill and Worm when using the "Horn of Action" relic.

Gameplay Changes:

 Adjusted NPC behavior for uninterested items. They no longer leave immediately, but they won’t pay as much as those who desire the item.

Bug Fixes:

 Fixed the wood storage bug.
 Fixed the shop speed adjustment bug (previously, shop speed could not be set after digging in the mining site once).
 Fixed the mission reward bug (rewards would incorrectly display relics you already owned).
 Minor UI fixes.

I'm really grateful for all the bug reports, you guys always help me so much, thank you for that! :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44252786/d97c7abf4d4e21f515010a5f44073ec76cb67a81.gif

notes.title: Hotfix 0.821
notes.content:
TerraForge patch 0.821 is now available!

New Features

 Added time control buttons to the Shop.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed the worm lag bug.
 Fixed the price reset bug that occurred after leaving the Shop.
 Fixed an issue where the mining site UI would not open after being closed during the first tutorial dialog.

Thank you everyone for all the support & feedback!

notes.title: Update 0.82 & My dev roadmap
notes.content:
TerraForge update 0.82 is now available!

New Features
Logging Hut Building:

 Introduced a new building, the Logging Hut, with multiple tier upgrades.
 Each upgrade provides additional benefits, including increased wood storage capacity.
 Once repaired, lumberjacks will search the area daily and bring back wood, which will now be stored based on the capacity of the Logging Hut.

Inn Enhancements:

 Added more unlockable tiers to the Inn.
 New modifiers have been introduced to further customize and enhance the Inn.

Improvements:
City Scene Graphics:

 Implemented minor graphical improvements to enhance the visual quality of the city scene.

I've put together a quick roadmap for TerraForge, which you can check out here.
I'll be updating the roadmap regularly as I continue developing the game, so feel free to check back for more details and progress updates!

notes.title: Update 0.8 - The Shop
notes.content:
TerraForge update 0.8 is now available!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44252786/e955e99fee86eb379034764b599201e677ff9d10.png

New Shop System:

Run your very own shop and attract customers to sell your crafted items. You set the price, but beware: there's a supply and demand system in place. While it's easy to spread your shop's influence and gain fame, it can also drop quickly if your customers are unhappy.
Find and reuse old furnitures buried in the ground throughout Quidland and customize your shop to your heart's content.
Furniture not only makes your shop more attractive but also boosts your customers' moods, making them more generous with their wallets.
Haggle system: Don't worry if you overpriced your items; many customers are willing to haggle. Negotiate the best price while keeping customers happy.
The demands for items constantly change from day to day, so you'll need to adapt.

There was a few bug fixes and improvements as well, but I got too involved in development and didn't write it down, so I don't know what it was anymore. ːlunar2019crylaughingpigː 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44252786/409d8ce900d9d80b3804a4bb15b8aa1b0575bd70.png

Future plans for the Shop (for later update):

Get ready for some friendly competition! Competing stores will challenge you to become the best in the region. Can you rise to the top and make the most profit from your crafted items?
Get ready for some competition! Beat all the other blacksmith stores from the region.
Brace yourselves for random events that shake up the supply and demand system, affect competitive stores, and even sway the attitudes of your customers. Adaptability is key to success!
Participate in mini-competitions and launch shop advertisements to attract more customers and increase your revenue.

I know that even with the shop the game loop needs more interesting elements and I will add more that's for sure! The next big update will be the Hazard update which will bring interesting elements to the mining process. I want it more difficult and fun. There will be also more stuffs to spend the money for!
I really want to make TerraForge more enjoyable so you guys can have more fun and hopefully it takes you away from the stress of everyday life, that's my goal :)

Thank you everyone for the patience and support; You all are truly awesome!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44252786/c3ecaa5078eecd8fa58a80bed46364d52f34f84f.gif

notes.title: New update in progress
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

I hope you're all doing well! It's time for a quick update on the latest developments.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44252786/c3ecaa5078eecd8fa58a80bed46364d52f34f84f.gif

New Shop System:

 Run your very own shop and attract customers to sell your crafted items. You set the price, but beware: there's a supply and demand system in place. While it's easy to spread your shop's influence and gain fame, it can also drop quickly if your customers are unhappy.
 Find new furnitures and customize your shop to your heart's content.
 Upgrade your shop to unlock more space. More space means more profit — yay!
 Keep an eye out for furniture imbued with mystic energy. These magical items can boost your customers' satisfaction, make them more generous with their wallets, or even deter would-be thieves!


Future Plans (for later update):

 Get ready for some friendly competition; Competitive stores will challenge you to become the best in the region. Can you rise to the top and make the most profit from your crafted items?
 Brace yourselves for random events that shake up the supply and demand system, affect competitive stores, and even sway the attitudes of your customers. Adaptability is key to success!
 Participate in mini-competitions and launch shop advertisements to attract more customers and increase your revenue.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44252786/7751ec4e8fbb23edfb71ecf852277c64a43352d7.png

I know it's been a while since the last update, and for that, I sincerely apologize. 🙏
Developing the game solo while juggling work has presented its challenges, and progress on the new big update has been slower than expected. I ask for your continued patience as I work tirelessly to bring you the best possible gaming experience I can create.

Your unwavering support and dedication mean the world to me, and I can't thank you enough for playing my game and eagerly awaiting updates. From the bottom of my heart, thank you. ♥

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44252786/7ee138a1fd5837ef4d8cfdfe13b7232931faa532.png

notes.content:
TerraForge patch 0.701 is now available!


 Auto crafting items now gives a small amount of crafting XP and manually crafting items gives more XP now.
 Changed the spawn logic for chunk types; ore chunk spawns only if mining licence contains that ore type.

notes.title: Update 0.7 - Chunks, Inn, new campsite and more!
notes.content:
TerraForge v.0.7 is now available!


 Recreated the whole campsite.
 Added a new ore chunk system. Now you can find big ore chunks underground and destroy them to get lots of resources. There is a little variety of these chunks, different drop chances and hp for every type of ore. (Detector can discover and mark them)
 Added a new building, the Inn. You can upgrade it and unlock new tiers to gain more buffs.
 Added Celestium to the game; mineable ore and chunks. (Celestium will be the catalyst to reach the Abyss, which will come in a future update)
 Added few QoL changes; loading screen, missing sound feedback for button press, etc. (I'll do more QoL changes soon)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44252786/3bd4460e94d36e4f1d102724d5b2fbdf1768746f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44252786/c2a4b93a771d14250a5c4e8297a822053476135f.png

As we all gather with our loved ones, or enjoy our own peaceful solitude during these holidays, I want to wish you warmth, joy, and endless fun. Whether you're exploring new worlds in-game or taking a well-deserved break, may your holidays be filled with happiness and relaxation.

Thank you for being here, playing my game and thank you so much for all the support! It means the world to me, and I can't wait to see what await us in the coming year.

🌟🎄 Happy Holidays and a Joyful New Year! 🎄🌟

notes.title: Update 0.68
notes.content:
TerraForge patch 0.68 is now available!


 A bit rework on utility tools; A new energy pool added for [Magnet], [Scan], [Detector].
 Reworked Magnet: Now it will collect ores and give boost to nearby tools and extract more ore from the same amount of veins as it attracts all bit of crumbs.
 Added favourite system for blueprints; Now you can set your own favourite blueprints and filter them.
 Decreased the penalty for pressing wrong letter and for pressing space in wrong position when doing crafting minigames.
 Increased chance for finding deeper mines with at least 2-day-long licences.
 Now you can pick up multiple ores by holding the mouse key.
 Changed upgrade text for several upgrade values.
 Fixed a money exploit, when pressed SELL ALL button rapidly it sold the same items multiple times. 
 Fixed a mission - collect 35 gold - which did not track the progress.
 Fixed autocrafted items mission tracking. Now the crafted amount correctly counts for crafting missions.
 Fixed Lens of Clarity (random scans) sometimes scanned outside of playable area.


Thank you so much for playing my game and stay tuned, next update will be big and will include new stuffs and features!

notes.title: Hotfix 0.675
notes.content:
TerraForge patch 0.675 is now available!


Fixed saving wipe bug, I had to rewrite the saving process; replaced the unity built-in binary saving because of inconsistent file reading and serializable class parsing.
Fixed missions save/load bug as well.
Fixed the infinite sonar "cheat", now energy will only regenerate after you begin mining.
Added warning messages when mining and the remaining time is only 60 and 10 seconds.
The game will also run in the background from now on.


Thank you everyone for the patience & feedback, you guys rock!
Special thanks for helping me with the save bug: Anthony, Oke, amoredis, drewfog and my brother Netscape.

Thank you everyone for the support & feedback, you guys are the best!

notes.title: TerraForge is now available in Early Access!
notes.content:
Greetings, aspiring blacksmiths!
I'm thrilled to announce that TerraForge is now available on Steam! ⛏️

To celebrate this, there is an exclusive 15% launch discount for all early adopters.

Join our community discussions on Discord or on Steam forums. Share your experiences, report bugs, write your own ideas and contribute to the development and help shape the game.

Thank you for being part of this journey!
Now grab your pickaxe, ready your anvil, and let the forging frenzy begin! ⚒️
